Product Features

  • Headboard with LED lighting The bed skilfully combines elegant design and maximum comfort. Decorative decorative buttons refine the headboard and give it a modern touch. The LED lighting adds modern style to your bedroom, with the remote control you can change the different colors and brightness for comfortable lying.
  • Storage Design: The bed is equipped with 4 drawers with large capacity. Two sides of the bed are equipped with drawer buckles that allow the drawer to be firmly attached to the bed when the drawer is not in use, so that your bedroom is tidy. The storage boxes are easy to roll out and roll in thanks to the wheels on the bottom. You can also remove the drawer and store large items under the bed.
  • Durable quality: To prevent some shifting of the mattress, non-slip strips are attached to the transition of the slats. The soft materials of the bed not only provide a comfortable feeling, but also effectively reduce damage from sharp corners and edges that you or your family would probably suffer in use.
  • Strong Construction: The slats are attached to the bed frame with Velcro. The additional support legs of the center bar can ensure the reliable stability of the bed. Maximum Load Capacity: 600LBS
  • Detailed information :D This bed is available in black and grey, neutral tones match all existing furniture.To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame is shipped in 2 boxes and these can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.
